summary: Co-Diagnostics filed an 8-K disclosing a $3.0M private placement with institutional and accredited investors. The company will issue 54,915 shares of common stock at $1.821 per unit (share plus common warrant), pre-funded warrants to purchase 1,592,532 shares at $0.0001 each, and common warrants for 3,294,894 shares exercisable at $1.571 per share for five years. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes. Maxim Group LLC acted as exclusive placement agent. The deal includes a 60-day lock-up on further equity issuance. This is a capital-raising event, not a strategic restructuring or acquisition. What to watch: potential dilution from warrant exercise and aftermarket stock price pressure.
